name: Alarmy - Alarm Clock & Sleep
dev: Sleep Tracker & Alarm Clock by Delightroom

android.desc:
Boost your mornings with Alarmy – a loud alarm clock app for heavy sleepers!
Wake up refreshed and motivated every day using customizable alarm missions and powerful alarm sounds.
Loud Alarm Clock App
Are you tired of regular alarms not working? Our loud alarm clock app comes with ultra-powerful alarm sounds like “End of the World” and “Cock-a-doodle-doo,” making it perfect for heavy sleepers. No more oversleeping – this alarm app is louder and smarter.

Smart Wake-Up Missions
Can’t wake up? This app includes fun and powerful alarm missions:

- Barcode & photo alarm: force yourself to get out of bed
- Math alarm & memory: get your brain moving
- Typing motivation quotes: boost your mindset
- Shake or squat alarm: physical activity to eliminate sleep inertia

Special Mode for Snooze Addicts
Break your snooze habit with Wake Up Check – if you ignore the alarm, your wake up alarm missions restart.
Perfect for anyone who needs the strongest way to get out of bed.

Alarm Clock App for Students & Workers
Set your app to match your lifestyle:
- Students can scan their textbook with a barcode alarm to jump into study mode
- Office workers can use loud alarm sounds and typing alarm missions for an energy boost

Customizable Sounds & Routines
Choose from dozens of loud alarm clock tones or peaceful alarm melodies.
Whether you love music alarms, or strong alarm tones, we’ve got you covered.

Build your morning routine and evening habit with an alarm that changes your behavior.

Sleep Better with Sleep Tracker
Great mornings start with good sleep. Use our sleep tracker to monitor your sleep cycle and record your snoring.

Pair it with calm sleep sounds like rain, ocean waves, or ASMR for deeper rest.

Alarmy isn’t just for waking – it’s for sleeping better too.

Recommended For:
- Deep sleepers looking for a reliable loud alarm clock app
- Users who want to build a morning routine or consistent habit
- Students with intense study schedules
- People who want to track and improve their sleep with our sleep tracker

Motivation Boost Features
- Set your alarm clock app background to motivational quotes or videos
- Use typing alarm missions to recite your goals every morning

Life Hacks with Alarmy
Study Mode

- Choose Photo Mission
- Register your textbook cover
- Wake up + start studying instant productivity

Sleep Routine

- Play calming sleep sounds
- Track with sleep tracker
- Repeat 5+ nights to build a healthy
